businessRules.name: Sign-in is not attendance
businessRules.invariant: Present requires successful clock-in and clock-out.

businessRules.name: Actual print material use
businessRules.invariant: Complete requires actual material usage and QC evidence.

businessRules.name: Actual bakery yield
businessRules.invariant: Completion requires nonnegative actual yield; expected yield is never substituted.

businessRules.name: Loaf and money reconciliation
businessRules.invariant: Unexplained quantity or cash variance blocks reconciliation.

businessRules.name: Proof of delivery
businessRules.invariant: A trip cannot be delivered or closed without POD evidence.

businessRules.name: Maker-checker decisions
businessRules.invariant: Maker cannot approve their own controlled request; decision reason is required.

businessRules.name: Balanced journal
businessRules.invariant: Posting requires finite equal debit and credit values in an open period.

businessRules.name: Commitment recognition
businessRules.invariant: Approval alone creates no active commitment. Ordered and partial-received balances do.

businessRules.name: Receipt accountability
businessRules.invariant: Accepted plus rejected quantity equals delivered quantity.

businessRules.name: Human publication approval
businessRules.invariant: Human approval and explicit Publish permission precede any simulated publication.

businessRules.name: Zero disclosure
businessRules.invariant: No assignment means no disclosure; missing and unauthorized resources share a neutral result.

businessRules.name: Specialized permission
businessRules.invariant: Export, Pay, Publish and other specialized actions are explicit, never implied by a level.

businessRules.name: Config safety
businessRules.invariant: No arbitrary SQL/JavaScript; protected business invariants cannot be disabled.

businessRules.name: Stock custody
businessRules.invariant: Transfer closure requires received quantity equal to dispatched quantity.

businessRules.name: Borrowed stock
businessRules.invariant: Closure requires the full issued quantity returned.

businessRules.name: Payroll readiness
businessRules.invariant: Net pay, bank validation, statutory configuration and approval are separate gates.

metrics.name: Active purchase commitment
metrics.formula: sum((ordered quantity − received quantity) × unit cost), ordered/partial only

metrics.name: Unexplained loaf variance
metrics.formula: actual yield − store balance − disposition quantities − approved resolution

metrics.name: Unexplained remittance variance
metrics.formula: agent sold × unit price − remittance − approved resolution
